name: @intellectual-frontiers/evidence-capture
description: The unattended capture of evidence: which assets are due, the canonical state of each kept on a branch of Git with a commit only where it changed, a hash-chained journal of every look, batched commits and a push that is configured, never forced.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun ../kanon/src/check.ts && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/
